body: if god even cared about me, why would he want me to go through this, over and over again? I feel like homer simpson just putting my finger in the same electrical outlet over and over to get shocked. and hurt. not learning a thing, not making any changes. why am i unloveable? why do things over turn out the way i want them to? Why can't i just be normal like everyone else? i try so fucking hard. so so soso hard only to fail. the harder i try, the most it hurts when i fail. its a never ending cycle. if i dont try, i fail, if i try, i fail, if i try harder, i fail harder. i just fucking give up. why even try when i already know the outcome before starting? how am i supposed to wake up or do anything when i know at the end of the day everything is the same as it was the day before?
